about: The cart's pages, drawn twice: by the CMS (cms/app/views/cart/, cms/app/helpers/cart_helper.rb, cms/app/models/cart_page.rb), which serves them at /cart and /cart/thanks, and by the browser demo (builder/src/demo/cart-view.tsx, cart-page.ts), which draws the same cart from the browser's storage. Each case gives what both read: the products collection, its products as they went live, the cart's lines as kept, and what the page says; each side prices the cart by its own twin of the shop's rules and draws <main>'s content, which cms/test/contract/cart_goldens_test.rb writes to <name>.html beside this file and the demo's cart.contract.test.tsx compares its own with. The pictures are the render contract's: /media/<id>.png, 800 by 600, none for an id starting with missing. See contract/README.md.
